subject: Initial security notice — auth anomaly observed & SOC 2 evidence request
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@northridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: [Security Notice] Auth anomaly observed against sandbox tenant

Hi Priyom,

We observed a series of unusual authentication attempts against our dev sandbox (tenant ID: NR-SBX-004). The attempts appear to come from IP ranges that resolve to Redwood-hosted infrastructure. At this time we have not detected lateral movement or production impact, but we wanted to notify you immediately and request a short evidence inventory so our SOC and auditors can track the event.

What we can share from our side: small audit snippet (attached) showing timestamps and originating IPs. Can Redwood confirm whether any of your infra made automated requests to our tenant around 2025-08-03T15:00:00Z? If there was legitimate activity, please provide the following:
- Short timeline of actions (UTC)
- Any service account or job names that performed auth attempts
- Relevant logs (redacted) or pointer to a forensic bundle we can ingest
- Indicate whether this event needs to be escalated under our SOC 2 / SIG process

We are happy to open a transient shared folder for the bundle. Please advise what documents your team will need (SOC 2 controls mapping, runbooks, post-incident report).

Thanks,
Emily Park
Security Operations
NorthRidge Financial

Attachments: audit-snippet.csv (text/csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Security Notice] Auth anomaly observed against sandbox tenant

Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the snippet. We're treating this as an incident notification and kicking off our triage.

Quick answers:
- We have no scheduled jobs that should authenticate to NR-SBX-004 at that UTC time.
- I've asked infra to capture the candidate request traces and verify IP assignment. Karthik is on the thread and will escalate to forensics if needed.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) We'll compile a short evidence bundle (logs + connection metadata) and share over a secure transfer link.
2) We will map the activity to SOC 2 control IDs (incident detection/response controls) and provide a control-level statement for your auditors.
3) We'll produce a post-incident summary (timeline, impact, mitigations) within 72 hours unless containment requires immediate disclosure.

Can you confirm if NorthRidge needs a signed NDA amendment or an alternate sharing mechanism for the forensic bundle? Also let us know if you need the SIG/CAIQ mappings; we can include a compact crosswalk.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-06T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary and evidence bundle (NorthRidge)

Emily — thanks for your patience. Attached is a compact forensic bundle and our post-incident summary. Key points up front:

- Timeline: Unusual auth attempts observed 2025-08-03T14:58:12Z — 2025-08-03T15:12:05Z. Attempts originated from a transient build runner that executed an automated test harness; that runner used a misconfigured service account (credential rotation gap).
- Impact: No access to production tenants detected. Attempts reached only the sandbox tenant NR-SBX-004.
- Root cause: A pipeline job deployed on 2025-07-31 created a service account with broader-than-intended permissions and credential rotation did not include that identity.
- Mitigations completed: revoked the service account, rotated keys, tightened CI runner network egress rules, added additional alerting for cross-tenant auth attempts.
- SOC 2 mapping: Controls for change management and privileged access (CC6, CC7) were relevant; we include a one-page crosswalk in the bundle.

Attachments in the secure share: redwood-forensic-bundle-20250803.zip (logs + sanitized traces), postmortem-20250806.pdf (executive summary + control crosswalk). We redacted customer PII and included an integrity checksum for the bundle.

If you'd like a short walkthrough call, I'm available tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT. Otherwise we'll assume this closes the notification loop and will file the incident as Resolved in our IR tracker.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-forensic-bundle-20250803.zip (application/zip), postmortem-20250806.pdf (application/pdf)
